name: Velocity Wishlist
author: velocityplugins

sections.description:
Velocity Wishlist is a powerful and modern wishlist plugin for WooCommerce that helps customers save products for later purchase. The plugin supports both logged-in users and guests, providing a seamless shopping experience.

Features

  • Fast and lightweight
  • Support for logged-in users and guests
  • Modern and responsive design
  • Easy integration with WooCommerce
  • Customizable button positions
  • AJAX-powered for smooth user experience
  • Translation ready

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or higher
  • WooCommerce 4.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/velocity-wishlist directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the WooCommerce->Settings->Wishlist screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with guest users?

Yes, the plugin supports both logged-in users and guests using session storage.

Is the plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
